tweets.text: What do you actually buy someone who's always tired or sore? Not another candle. Here's what recovery gifts really work -- broken down by price, not hype.

Recovery & sleep gift ideas by budget: Under $50 -> magnesium glycinate, weighted sleep mask, mini massage ball. Under $100 -> weighted blanket, entry-level massage gun, handheld red light device. Under $500 -> sauna blanket, portable cold plunge tub, Oura Ring / WHOOP.

Common gift mistake: buying the most expensive recovery gadget you can find. Better move: match the gift to what they actually struggle with -- sleep, soreness, or stress. A $30 magnesium supplement can beat a $400 gadget nobody asked for.

Full 2026 recovery & sleep gift guide: Under $50, $100, and $500 -- plus who to buy for (Mom, Dad, him, her, coworker). Real comparisons, no hype: https://lionlion0201-jpg.github.io/home-recovery-blog/posts/best-recovery-and-sleep-gifts-2026/
